1418-2226-2805.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1418-2226-2805.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Kiri-Onna by paying its mana cost.
When Kiri-Onna enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

3088-4828-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3088-4828-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3088-4828-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

983-2645-5963-6871-7115.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
983-2645-5963-6871-7115.description:
Cast Staff of Domination by paying {3}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Temple of the False God.
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Temple of the False God's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat from step 6.

1278-2292-3327-4508.easyPrerequisites: Lightning-Rig Crew doesn't have summoning sickness.
1278-2292-3327-4508.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1278-2292-3327-4508.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} due to its cost reduction, including its commander tax.
Lightning-Rig Crew triggers, untapping it.
Resolve Dargo. Then, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

512-1336-4091.easyPrerequisites:
Heronblade Elite and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
Heronblade Elite has power 2 or greater.
512-1336-4091.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Heronblade Elite, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1336-4091.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Heronblade Elite's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

245-2034-4772.description:
Activate Marneus by paying {6}, creating four creature tokens due to Doubling Season.
When the tokens enter, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three creature tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

4381-4694-5256-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4381-4694-5256-7306.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 1.

978-5147--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with persist
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

586-3375-3899-5258-5618.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1325-5170-5256-6132.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Kheru Bloodsucker trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

6798-7084-7885.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1643-2073-2921-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

433-1174-7857.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control a mana-producing land.
433-1174-7857.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer  triggers, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Activate the land and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping another land.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7607.easyPrerequisites: There are at least one land card in all graveyards
5147-6972-7607.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Centaur Vinecrasher.
When Centaur Vinecrasher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

240-5470-6798-7060.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat from step 2.

1308-2457-4289-4460.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1020-2034-2866-5060.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact or creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
1020-2034-2866-5060.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Cemetery Prowler.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Cemetery Prowler.
Repeat.

1409-5423-6441.description:
Activate Swashbuckler Extraordinaire by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Swashbuckler Extraordinaire enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Swashbuckler Extraordinaire.
Resolve the Swashbuckler Extraordinaire trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-3875-5414.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3875-5414.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Tireless Provisioner and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

457-654-2043-6741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six multicolored permanents.
457-654-2043-6741.description:
Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Infinite Guideline Station that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Put the Infinite Guideline Station token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Infinite Guideline Station token enters, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
When the Robots enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Robots.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer six times by tapping six Robots, adding six {U}.
Repeat.
457-654-2043-6741.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

4050-4484-6026-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4050-4484-6026-6896.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} due to Green Goblin.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}.
When Ebondeath dies, Field of Souls triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

478-2593-6871.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Astral Cornucopia and Candelabra of Tawnos as they are lands due to Toph.
Repeat.

339-647-677-2438.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3000-5670-6794.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-5670-6794.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

2421-2510-5231-6711.manaNeeded: {R}{R} if Sabin is in your graveyard or {2}{R} plus commander tax if applicable otherwise
2421-2510-5231-6711.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional card in hand.
2421-2510-5231-6711.description:
If Sabin is in your graveyard, cast it for its blitz cost by paying {R}{R} and discarding a card. Otherwise, cast Sabin either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Sabin and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Choose not to return Sabin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sabin dies, if it was cast using its blitz ability, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3470-4693-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn
3470-4693-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger that many times.
Resolve all Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G} for each trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1409-3809-6348.description:
Activate Sarkhan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sarkhan enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Sarkhan trigger, choosing Goldspan Dragon and creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sarkhan.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

2511-4336-5220-5683.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Kobolds of Kher Keep and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.

11-957-5257.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}.
Riku's first ability triggers - choose not to pay.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Time Stretch.
Riku's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {U}{R} to copy Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Time Stretch, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal created in step 5, copying Time Stretch and returning the original Time Stretch to your hand.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat each turn.
11-957-5257.notes: You may pay an additional {U}{R} to copy the extra turn spell, and only need to do this loop during your fourth extra turn.

1365-3263-4050-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-3263-4050-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Repeat.

2921-3605-5145.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1170-1477-5034-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-5034-5131.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Sol Ring, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Cast Sol Ring from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
Repeat.

235-3681-5438.description:
Cast Explosive Singularity by paying at most {8}{R}{R}, dealing 10 damage to any creature.
Imodane triggers, giving each opponent ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

215-3129-3426-4050.description:
Cast Deranged Hermit by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Squirrels, adding {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deranged Hermit to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1651-2585-3094-4131-4176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five additional artifacts.
1651-2585-3094-4131-4176.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Karn's ability.
Resolve the copy of Karn's ability, adding {C} for each artifact you control that cannot be spent to cast nonartifact spells.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Basalt Monolith and Grim Monolith, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Activate Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {4}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

600-1543-3062.notablePrerequisites: Jace has at least five loyalty counters on it.
600-1543-3062.description:
Activate Jace's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two token copies of it that aren't legendary.
Activate a Jace token using the first ability from Ichormoon Gauntlet by putting zero loyalty counters on it, proliferating and putting two loyalty counters onto each Jace.
Activate the second Jace token's third ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two token copies of itself that aren't legendary.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite Jace tokens with infinite loyalty counters, starting on your next turn, you may activate any number of instances of the second ability granted by Ichormoon Gauntlet by removing loyalty counters from Jace tokens to take infinite turns.

3808-4871-5295.description:
Activate Halsin by paying {1}, causing a Treasure token to become a 4/4 Bear creature token in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate the Treasure Bear token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
The Treasure Bear dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
